grid.expression: WITH BASE_COMISSOES AS ( SELECT COM.CODVEND, COM.NUFINORIG, COM.NUNOTAORIG, COM.NUFIN, COM.NUMOSORIG, COM.NUMITEMORIG, COM.TIPO, COM.CODFORM, CASE WHEN NVL(COM.AD_REVISADO, 'N') = 'S' THEN 'S' ELSE 'N' END AS AD_REVISADO, MAX(NVL(VCOM.COMLIQ, 0)) AS VALOR_COMISSAO FROM VGFCOM_FECH VCOM INNER JOIN TGFCOM COM ON COM.CODVEND = VCOM.CODVEND AND NVL(COM.NUNOTAORIG, -1) = NVL(VCOM.NUNOTAORIG, -1) AND NVL(COM.NUFINORIG, -1) = NVL(VCOM.NUFINORIG, -1) AND NVL(COM.NUMOSORIG, -1) = NVL(VCOM.NUMOSORIG, -1) AND NVL(COM.NUMITEMORIG, -1) = NVL(VCOM.NUMITEMORIG, -1) AND NVL(COM.TIPO, '#') = NVL(VCOM.TIPO, '#') AND NVL(COM.CODFORM, -1) = NVL(VCOM.CODFORM, -1) WHERE ( ( VCOM.DTNEG BETWEEN :PERIODO.INI AND :PERIODO.FIN AND VCOM.POSICAO_QUERY = '1' ) OR ( ( ( VCOM.TIPCALC = 'N' AND VCOM.DTNEG BETWEEN :PERIODO.INI AND :PERIODO.FIN ) OR ( VCOM.DHBAIXA BETWEEN :PERIODO.INI AND :PERIODO.FIN ) ) AND VCOM.POSICAO_QUERY = '2' ) OR ( VCOM.DHBAIXA BETWEEN :PERIODO.INI AND :PERIODO.FIN AND VCOM.POSICAO_QUERY IN ('3', '4', '5', '6') ) OR ( ( VCOM.DHBAIXA BETWEEN :PERIODO.INI AND :PERIODO.FIN OR ( VCOM.TIPFATSERV IN ('S', 'U') AND VCOM.DHBAIXA < :PERIODO.INI AND VCOM.INICEXEC BETWEEN :PERIODO.INI AND :PERIODO.FIN ) ) AND VCOM.POSICAO_QUERY IN ('7', '8') ) ) AND VCOM.CODVEND = :CODVEND GROUP BY COM.CODVEND, COM.NUFINORIG, COM.NUNOTAORIG, COM.NUFIN, COM.NUMOSORIG, COM.NUMITEMORIG, COM.TIPO, COM.CODFORM, CASE WHEN NVL(COM.AD_REVISADO, 'N') = 'S' THEN 'S' ELSE 'N' END ), SITUACOES AS ( SELECT 'S' AS AD_REVISADO, 'Revisadas' AS STATUS_REVISAO, '#28A745' AS FAROL_REVISAO, 1 AS ORDEM FROM DUAL UNION ALL SELECT 'N' AS AD_REVISADO, 'Pendentes' AS STATUS_REVISAO, '#DC3545' AS FAROL_REVISAO, 2 AS ORDEM FROM DUAL ) SELECT SIT.FAROL_REVISAO, SIT.STATUS_REVISAO, COUNT(BASE.CODVEND) AS QUANTIDADE_COMISSOES, NVL(SUM(BASE.VALOR_COMISSAO), 0) AS VALOR_COMISSAO FROM SITUACOES SIT LEFT JOIN BASE_COMISSOES BASE ON BASE.AD_REVISADO = SIT.AD_REVISADO GROUP BY SIT.FAROL_REVISAO, SIT.STATUS_REVISAO, SIT.ORDEM ORDER BY SIT.ORDEM

SELECT /* Controle da revisão: manter no início da grade */ COM.AD_REVISADO AS AD_REVISADO, CASE WHEN NVL(COM.AD_REVISADO, 'N') = 'S' THEN 'Revisada' ELSE 'Pendente' END AS STATUS_REVISAO, REV.NOMEUSU AS NOME_REVISOR, COM.AD_DHREV AS AD_DHREV,
CASE WHEN NVL(COM.AD_REVISADO, 'N') = 'S' THEN '#28A745' ELSE '#DC3545' END AS FAROL_REVISAO,
/* Mesma ordem funcional da tela Fechamento de Comissões */ VCOM.NOMEPARC AS NOMEPARC, VCOM.COMISSAO AS COMISSAO, VCOM.PERCCOM AS PERCCOM, VCOM.VLRBAIXA AS VLRBAIXA, VCOM.NUMNOTA AS NUMNOTA, VCOM.NUNOTA AS NUNOTA, VCOM.COMLIQ AS COMLIQ, VCOM.VLRCOM AS VLRCOM, VCOM.COMLIQ AS COMISSAO_PARCELA, VCOM.DESCROPER AS DESCROPER, VCOM.FINNUFIN AS FINNUFIN, VCOM.DESCRFORM AS DESCRFORM, VCOM.VLRDESDOB AS VLRDESDOB, VCOM.DHBAIXA AS DHBAIXA, COM.CODVEND AS CODVEND, VCOM.APELIDO AS APELIDO, COM.NUNOTAORIG AS NUNOTAORIG, VCOM.CODEMP AS CODEMP, EMP.NOMEFANTASIA AS NOMEFANTASIA, VCOM.CODPARC AS CODPARC, VCOM.CODPARCVEN AS CODPARCVEN, COM.TIPO AS TIPO, VCOM.VLRDESC AS VLRDESC, VCOM.DESCRNAT AS DESCRNAT, NVL(OPC_TIPCALC.OPCAO, VCOM.TIPCALC) AS TIPCALC_DESCRICAO, VCOM.DESDOBRAMENTO AS DESDOBRAMENTO, VCOM.DTVENC AS DTVENC, VCOM.CODTIPTIT AS CODTIPTIT, VCOM.DHCONCILIACAO AS DHCONCILIACAO, VCOM.NOSSONUM AS NOSSONUM, VCOM.DTNEG AS DTNEG, VCOM.DTFATUR AS DTFATUR, VCOM.CODTIPVENDA AS CODTIPVENDA, COM.NUMOSORIG AS NUMOSORIG, COM.NUMITEMORIG AS NUMITEMORIG, NVL(OPC_TIPMOV.OPCAO, VCOM.TIPMOV) AS TIPMOV_DESCRICAO, COM.NUFINORIG AS NUFINORIG, VCOM.TAXA AS TAXA, VCOM.CODEVENTO AS CODEVENTO, VCOM.TIPINTEGRA AS TIPINTEGRA, COM.CODFORM AS CODFORM, VCOM.INICEXEC AS INICEXEC, VCOM.DTMOV AS DTMOV, VCOM.CODCENCUSPAD AS CODCENCUSPAD, NVL(OPC_RECDESP.OPCAO, TO_CHAR(FIN.RECDESP)) AS RECDESP_DESCRICAO,
/* Campos técnicos: manter no SELECT e ocultar na grade */ :PERIODO.INI AS PERIODO_INI, :PERIODO.FIN AS PERIODO_FIN, COM.NUFIN AS NUFIN, COM.AD_CODUSUREV AS AD_CODUSUREV, REV.EMAIL AS EMAIL_USUARIO_REVISOR, VCOM.POSICAO_QUERY AS POSICAO_QUERY, VCOM.TIPFATSERV AS TIPFATSERV
FROM VGFCOM_FECH VCOM
INNER JOIN TGFCOM COM ON COM.CODVEND = VCOM.CODVEND AND NVL(COM.NUNOTAORIG, -1) = NVL(VCOM.NUNOTAORIG, -1) AND NVL(COM.NUFINORIG, -1) = NVL(VCOM.NUFINORIG, -1) AND NVL(COM.NUMOSORIG, -1) = NVL(VCOM.NUMOSORIG, -1) AND NVL(COM.NUMITEMORIG, -1) = NVL(VCOM.NUMITEMORIG, -1) AND NVL(COM.TIPO, '#') = NVL(VCOM.TIPO, '#') AND NVL(COM.CODFORM, -1) = NVL(VCOM.CODFORM, -1)
LEFT JOIN TSIEMP EMP ON EMP.CODEMP = VCOM.CODEMP
LEFT JOIN TGFFIN FIN ON FIN.NUFIN = VCOM.FINNUFIN
LEFT JOIN TGFPAR PAR ON PAR.CODPARC = VCOM.CODPARC
LEFT JOIN TGFVEN VEN ON VEN.CODVEND = VCOM.CODVEND
LEFT JOIN TSIUSU REV ON REV.CODUSU = COM.AD_CODUSUREV
LEFT JOIN ( SELECT OPC.VALOR, MAX(OPC.OPCAO) AS OPCAO FROM TDDCAM CAM INNER JOIN TDDOPC OPC ON OPC.NUCAMPO = CAM.NUCAMPO WHERE CAM.NOMETAB = 'TGFVEN' AND CAM.NOMECAMPO = 'TIPCALC' GROUP BY OPC.VALOR ) OPC_TIPCALC ON OPC_TIPCALC.VALOR = VCOM.TIPCALC
LEFT JOIN ( SELECT OPC.VALOR, MAX(OPC.OPCAO) AS OPCAO FROM TDDCAM CAM INNER JOIN TDDOPC OPC ON OPC.NUCAMPO = CAM.NUCAMPO WHERE CAM.NOMETAB = 'TGFCAB' AND CAM.NOMECAMPO = 'TIPMOV' GROUP BY OPC.VALOR ) OPC_TIPMOV ON OPC_TIPMOV.VALOR = VCOM.TIPMOV
LEFT JOIN ( SELECT OPC.VALOR, MAX(OPC.OPCAO) AS OPCAO FROM TDDCAM CAM INNER JOIN TDDOPC OPC ON OPC.NUCAMPO = CAM.NUCAMPO WHERE CAM.NOMETAB = 'TGFFIN' AND CAM.NOMECAMPO = 'RECDESP' GROUP BY OPC.VALOR ) OPC_RECDESP ON OPC_RECDESP.VALOR = TO_CHAR(FIN.RECDESP)
WHERE ( ( VCOM.DTNEG BETWEEN :PERIODO.INI AND :PERIODO.FIN AND VCOM.POSICAO_QUERY = '1' )
OR
( ( ( VCOM.TIPCALC = 'N' AND VCOM.DTNEG BETWEEN :PERIODO.INI AND :PERIODO.FIN ) OR ( VCOM.DHBAIXA BETWEEN :PERIODO.INI AND :PERIODO.FIN ) ) AND VCOM.POSICAO_QUERY = '2' )
OR
( VCOM.DHBAIXA BETWEEN :PERIODO.INI AND :PERIODO.FIN AND VCOM.POSICAO_QUERY IN ('3', '4', '5', '6') )
OR
( ( VCOM.DHBAIXA BETWEEN :PERIODO.INI AND :PERIODO.FIN OR ( VCOM.TIPFATSERV IN ('S', 'U') AND VCOM.DHBAIXA < :PERIODO.INI AND VCOM.INICEXEC BETWEEN :PERIODO.INI AND :PERIODO.FIN ) ) AND VCOM.POSICAO_QUERY IN ('7', '8') ) )
AND VCOM.CODVEND = :CODVEND
ORDER BY COM.CODVEND, COM.CODFORM, COM.NUNOTAORIG, VCOM.COMLIQ, COM.TIPO
